mentions.name: New Business Ideas Mailing List
mentions.description: A mailing list that follows a series of new business idea experiments, inviting subscribers to watch each new venture attempt as it is tested, building on a write-up of 25+ years of failed businesses.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been trying things for 25+ years and I'm about to kick off a test of a whole bunch of new business ideas. You might have read my article, How to Lose Money with 25 Years of Failed Businesses.

https://joeldare.com/how-to-lose-money-with-25-years-of-failed-businesses

I've created a mailing list. Please sign-up if seeing all my new business tries is something you might be interested in.

https://tally.so/r/wvggOX
